requirements.description: A movement preserves total material mass.

source.quote: Moving material between locations must never create or destroy mass.

verification.description: Generated valid movements preserve total mass.

requirements.notes: Example only; replace with requirements from the actual design.

requirements.description: A failed movement does not leave partial updates.

source.rationale: The design requires mass to be preserved but does not say what happens on failure; a partial update would break that rule, so a failed movement must roll back.

verification.description: Force a failure mid-operation and assert rollback.
